description: This file defines FastAPI dependencies and a route handler that utilizes dependency injection via Depends and Cookie to retrieve query parameters or cookie values.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' from the request, returns None if not provided.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
methods.description: Depends on query_extractor and Cookie to retrieve 'q' from query parameters or cookies, prioritizes 'q'.

methods.name: read_query(query_or_default: str = Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor))
methods.description: API endpoint that returns the value obtained from query_or_cookie_extractor as a JSON response.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
